abilities.name: Strength
abilities.description: The force behind a blow, the power in a grapple, the physical pressure that puts an opponent down.

abilities.name: Toughness
abilities.description: Absorbing punishment and staying functional. A tough character takes the same hits and keeps going.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.description: Speed, reflexes, and spatial awareness. Where Toughness absorbs, Agility avoids.

abilities.name: Intellect
abilities.description: Raw cognitive power — learning, recall, analysis, application. Drives the offensive use of knowledge and supernatural force.

abilities.name: Willpower
abilities.description: Mental endurance. Sustains concentration, resists psychic assault, holds focus under pressure.

abilities.name: Acuity
abilities.description: Situational awareness and instinctive reading of circumstances. The gut sense something is wrong before it lands.

abilities.name: Belief
abilities.description: Channeling conviction into power — divine force, healing, and spiritual assault. Used with Channel in the Magic Overlay.

abilities.name: Morale
abilities.description: Rallying and holding ground under emotional pressure. The courage to keep going when everything says to stop.

abilities.name: Serenity
abilities.description: Inner calm that withstands attacks on the soul. Where Morale resists, Serenity flows around.
